The '''Rainbow Trout''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] and [[Cindersap Forest]]) and the [[The Mountain|mountain lake]] during [[Summer]] during sunny [[weather]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Summer, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|65}}. On Summer 20th and 21st during the [[Trout Derby]] festival, Rainbow Trout can be caught in the Cindersap Forest during the entire day and regardless of weather. The fish can also be caught during Trout Derby without the normal restrictions in [[Farm Maps]] with Cindersap Forest fish, such as the Riverland, Hilltop, Forest, and Meadowlands farms. Rainbow Trout can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Rainbow Trout can be found in the river and the mountain lake. {{Map|270|43|loc2x=200|loc2y=150|loc3x=120|loc3y=150}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley }} ==Bundles== Rainbow Trout is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow}} {{:Trout Soup|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Rainbow Trout can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Fish Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt158.png|24px]] It can also be used as an orange dye in the dye pots located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Fish Pond== Rainbow Trout can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The primary output is orange Rainbow Trout [[Roe]]. However, more valuable items are possible starting at population 9, including a 0.09% daily chance of producing a [[Prismatic Shard]].
